text: Employees can spend up to $40 per month on standard office supplies without needing approval first.
A $60 supply purchase in one month is fine as long as the employee gets written approval before making it.
Equipment requests like monitors and keyboards are reimbursed the same way as the monthly supplies allowance.
Receipts submitted 20 days after purchase are still reimbursed as long as the item was pre-approved.
The company offers a stipend for employees to expense a home internet upgrade.
The IT procurement form for equipment requests can be submitted online.
